versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill card file (skill-card.md).
- No functional or user-facing changes were made.

Initial release of expiry-tracker.

- Track food expiry dates by scanning receipts or adding items manually.
- Receive daily alerts and "use this today" suggestions to help reduce food waste.
- Maintain an inventory of perishable items with detailed expiry tracking.
- Commands include adding, removing, listing, and generating waste reports.
- Supports bulk adding items from receipt text and infers expiry dates by food category.
